title: What Being Hard on Yourself Actually Means for a Godly Man
caption:
What being hard on yourself actually means for a godly man. It's not what most men use it to justify.

It means naming your sin before someone else has to. A higher standard for you than for anyone you love. Correcting yourself faster than you correct her.

Judge yourselves, and you will not be judged (1 Corinthians 11:31).

The point was never to hate yourself into holiness. It was to see clearly enough to let Him actually change you.
